create_transformer_representation: create a TransformerRepresentation with stacked multi-head self-attention and feed-forward layers for text inputs
configure_transformer_layers: configure the TransformerRepresentation Config with num_layers, num_attention_heads, ffnn_embed_dim, dropout, and scaling
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass on embedded tokens through transformer layers with a padding mask
review_transformer_layer_creation: review the _create_transformer_layer method that builds TransformerLayer with MultiheadSelfAttention and ResidualMLP
